name: Airplane Racing : Flight League
summary:
Enter the Flight League and experience high-speed airplane racing built for virtual reality.

Airplane Racing : Flight League puts you in control of a powerful racing aircraft as you compete against skilled AI pilots across dangerous aerial circuits. Fly through checkpoints, take alternate routes, avoid obstacles, and use perfectly timed boosts to gain the advantage.

Choose your challenge:

• Championship — compete through a series of races and fight for the league title.
• Arcade — jump directly into fast
